title: FIFA: Road to World Cup 98
overview:
The Only Goal Is to Qualify

Pick from 172 nations and take your team all the way to France 98.

- Virtual Motion Engine for unlimited fluid animation.
- Ultimate Control turn defences inside-out with twists and turns, accelerated dribbling, dummies, ball swerves and the old 'one-two'.
- Faster Gameplay including 'one-touch control' over passes, headers and volleys for lightning-fast action.
- 16 Accurately Represented In-game Stadia.
- 1997/98 Season line-ups for all 172 national and 189 domestic squads.
- Expert Commentary from John Motson, Andy Gray and Des Lynam.
- High Precision Football Details including player transfer feature, player/team editor and weather effects.
